appearance_comparison_without_models.method: simple frame statistics plus visual inspection of the contact sheet; no model inference or detections
appearance_comparison_without_models.preliminary_statistical_read: own_colony_val_002 is treated as a clean held-out own-colony source regardless of similarity; source-level separation is the guard.

visual_read.decision: Accepted as clean own-colony holdout annotation set; similarity to real domain is desired, not a reason to reject.
visual_read.own_colony_val_001: Conceptually similar failure-domain family: tube/plastic geometry, warm cast, glare/reflections, small own-colony ants. Exact source-video SHA is distinct, so it remains a clean holdout source.
visual_read.v4_train_source_groups: Most similar to chamber/tube/block-nest aspects rather than the broader topdown arena views; still held out at source level and not eligible for train or checkpoint selection.

freeze_policy.evaluation_timing: evaluate only after v4 selected.pt is selected and frozen using development validation

leakage_check.ant4_note: ant4 was not opened; verified only through source/path/manifest text guards.

selected_video.codec_long_name: H.264 / AVC / MPEG-4 AVC / MPEG-4 part 10

selection_policy.excluded_interval_reason: No intro/outro was excluded before deterministic selection.
selection_policy.replacement_rule: Only decode failure, corrupt frame, or completely black frame may be replaced.
selection_policy.strategy: 30 equal temporal bins over the full usable video interval; center frame from each bin.

notes: Contact sheet shows a stable own-colony scene across all 30 temporal bins; no intro/outro was excluded.
The scene uses a portrait/vertical colony composition inside a 1920x1080 frame, with yellow/orange substrate and visible plastic/tube geometry.
Glare/reflections and bright plastic/cotton-like edges are present, especially along the left and lower frame regions.
Visible adult-ant density appears sparse to low-medium across the sampled timeline; ants are small to medium and occur in changing positions.
Focus/contrast are sufficient for human annotation, with some real-world blur/reflection/occlusion that should remain part of the clean holdout.

visual_characterization.approximate_ant_density: sparse to low-medium in contact-sheet view
visual_characterization.camera_angle: fixed own-colony chamber/tube view; portrait-like scene content inside landscape video frame
visual_characterization.focus: usable, with mild blur/compression in places
visual_characterization.occlusion: plastic/tube edges and substrate texture may partially occlude or distract
visual_characterization.tube_plastic: visible translucent/plastic boundaries and circular tube/port region
